assignments.reason: אמונה is faith — the core concept of the new good bechina cluster (Package 3) identified in the additions file, where it forms a bechina chain with מצוות מעשיות, ידיו, and תפלה. Its essential nature is the positive force of simple faith that opposes philosophical inquiry. It appears as the cause node in the eitza edge 'אמונה → weakened Amalek'.

assignments.node_id: החליש את עמלק, דהינו החכמות והחקירות כנ"ל
assignments.node_text: הֶחֱלִישׁ אֶת עֲמָלֵק, דְּהַיְנוּ הַחָכְמוֹת וְהַחֲקִירוֹת כַּנַּ"ל
assignments.reason: This node describes the weakening of Amalek, explicitly glossed as 'the wisdoms and inquiries.' Its essential nature is Amalek and the philosophical-heretical force — the very subject matter of Package 1. Although the weakening is a positive outcome, the concept being weakened (Amalek / the external wisdoms and inquiries) belongs by essential nature to the evil package. The node names the evil force and its domain, not the good force that defeats it.

assignments.node_id: תמימות דיקא, דהינו יראת השם ומצוות מעשיות בפשיטות גמור
assignments.node_text: תְּמִימוּת דַּיְקָא, דְּהַיְנוּ יִרְאַת הַשֵּׁם וּמִצְווֹת מַעֲשִׂיּוֹת בִּפְשִׁיטוּת גָּמוּר
assignments.reason: This is an expanded form of תמימות ופשיטות, which the additions file identifies as a bechina of סוף דבר (Package 2). The Rebbe explicitly states: 'עִקָּר הַשָּׂגַת הַתַּכְלִית, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת סוֹף דָּבָר, הוּא רַק עַל־יְדֵי תְּמִימוּת וּפְשִׁיטוּת'. Its essential nature is the mode and substance of the ultimate purpose — simplicity in fearing God and keeping commandments. This is the content of what תכלית consists of, making it a natural member of Package 2.

This node is 'the essence of attaining the ultimate purpose.' Its essential nature is תכלית — the ultimate purpose itself, which is the dominant concept of Package 2. The node refers to the very same reality as תכלית and סוף דבר: the culmination and endpoint of human spiritual striving. It appears as the effect node in two eitza edges, both pointing to the same conclusion: that simplicity and faith lead to attaining the ultimate purpose.

assignments.node_id: אמונה ומצוות מעשיות, לעבד השם על פי התורה בתמימות ובפשיטות
assignments.node_text: אֱמוּנָה וּמִצְווֹת מַעֲשִׂיּוֹת, לַעֲבֹד הַשֵּׁם עַל־פִּי הַתּוֹרָה בִּתְמִימוּת וּבִפְשִׁיטוּת
assignments.reason: This compound node names אמונה and מצוות מעשיות as its primary subjects — both core members of the new Package 3 bechina cluster. While it also mentions תמימות ובפשיטות, the essential nature of this node is the active practice of faith and commandments, which is the domain of Package 3 (אמונה ותפלה). The simplicity mentioned here is the manner in which the faith is practiced, not the telos itself. The node serves as a cause leading to attaining the תכלית (Package 2), reflecting the eitza flow from the faith cluster to the purpose cluster.

new_packages.label: אֱמוּנָה וּתְפִלָּה
new_packages.reason: The additions file identifies a bechina chain not present in the original packages: ידיו ↔ מצוות מעשיות ↔ אמונה ↔ תפלה. These four concepts share the same essential nature — embodied, practical faith that opposes philosophical inquiry. The Rebbe makes explicit bechina identifications: 'יָדָיו – הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת מִצְווֹת מַעֲשִׂיּוֹת', 'שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת אֱמוּנָה', 'וֶאֱמוּנָה זֶה תְּפִלָּה'. This cluster forms the positive counterforce to Package 1 (Amalek) and the causal means to Package 2 (תכלית). אמונה is the dominant node with the most bechina connections in this chain.
